title: Orientation
description: Horizontal: a row of caps with the KPS block beside it. Vertical: a column of caps with counts to the right and KPS below; give the browser source more height (e.g. 360×640), otherwise the panel scales down to fit.

title: Cap size / px
description: Edge length of each key cap; clamped to 28–80 px. The panel scales down when many keys (e.g. 10K mania) would not fit the browser source.

title: Show KPS history
description: Bars of taps per second over the last 10 s; on the results screen, the whole attempt.

title: Show total taps
description: Sum of all key counts for the attempt.

title: Position anchor
description: Corner of the browser source the panel sticks to, so it grows away from that corner when the key count changes.
